description: Allowlisted SPDX license identifiers for pnpm dependencies (CLAUDE.md Section 4.9 gate #10). tools/security/license-check.mjs fails CI if `pnpm licenses list` reports anything not in this list. Add a license here only after confirming it's compatible with redistributing exported games (docs/SPEC.md Section 15.3) — that is the actual constraint, not just "permissive-sounding".
